description: Scan Polymarket contracts for mispricings against the PMP model (a probability swarm). Returns each market where the model disagrees with the price, the direction to take, the edge in percentage points, and quarter-Kelly sizing, sorted by absolute edge. The scanner is being rebuilt for the 2026 midterms and usually returns no rows today; the response says when it last ran. Pro — sign in with PredictionMarketsPicks, or a Pro API key. Use for "where is the edge today", "mispriced markets", "what should I trade".

limit.description: Max rows to return (default 10). Values above 25 are clamped to 25.

minEdge.description: Minimum absolute edge in pp to include (default 5). Accepts a number or a numeric string ("3", "3pp", "3%").

name: scan_mispricings
title: Scan Mispricings
